features.description: Encode Int / and % with Go truncating semantics on every emitter (div_Int, mod_Int, OpDiv/OpMod, BinOp / %, DictApp div)
acceptance_criteria: parity (x % 2, ensures result >= 0) gives a counterexample with negative x
halfDown (x / 2, ensures result * 2 <= x) gives a counterexample with negative x
halfNonNeg and a bounded-parity true control still VERIFY
No emitter in internal/smt produces bare SMT div/mod for Int
Mutation: reverting the encoding makes the new tests fail
features.notes: 981a7aee9. One applyBinaryOp/encodeTruncDivMod helper. A Z3 sign-table test covers all 8 emitter shapes. e2e: parity and halfDown give a counterexample at x = -1. Four true controls VERIFY; halfTowardZero flips from VIOLATION to VERIFIED. Both mutations (all-Euclidean, and mod_Int only) fail the tests.

features.description: Contract-as-spec callees become an uninterpreted <f>__spec function with a requires-guarded, call-triggered ensures axiom, instead of one shared result constant
acceptance_criteria: gap (total(a) - total(a + 1), ensures result == 0) gives a counterexample with a >= 0
A callee ensures that mentions its own parameter is instantiated with the call argument (atLeast VERIFIES)
Callee requires guards its ensures (no requires asserted as an axiom)
Counterexample model lists no junk lines for UF definitions
Mutation: reverting to a shared constant makes the new tests fail
features.notes: 5410d0b2f. <f>__spec uninterpreted function plus a requires => ensures quantified axiom with the call term as its pattern. parseModel skips non-nullary define-funs. e2e: gap gives a counterexample at a = 0 and atLeastUnguarded at a = -1; selfGap, sumBoth and atLeast VERIFY. Five mutations each fail a test: collapsed call sites, unguarded ensures, an unencodable requires keeping the ensures, parseModel printing junk, and the full pre-fix revert.
